name: comp-111
blurb: QR code icon and Sign in text as a split button pair.
description: Two grouped primary buttons: a QR code icon button and a 'Sign in' text button. Divided with a subtle line and rounded edges.
use_when: Offering QR code scanning as an alternative sign-in method.
avoid_when: When buttons should have different styles or colors.
a11y: Uses aria-label on the QR icon button and aria-hidden on the icon.
